journeys.name: Park and restore Myrick
journeys.task_statement: Find the Myrick work record, park it with a reason, prove its history survived, then bring it back.
journeys.friction_notes: Park half run fully unaided: Joe located the exact record, prepared a parking reason, confirmed, and reached the preserved-history and read-back verification without help. Joe then reported the journey done while the artifact still read Parked, version 8, restore unconfirmed, all five pressure fields Excluded. Cause per Joe verbatim: 'i didn't realize your entire question. so i didn't click restore bc i didn't notice your instruction included that step. I defintely saw the button and it was self explanatory.' This is a PROCTOR INSTRUMENT ERROR, not a product defect — the four-clause task statement was issued as a single sentence and the fourth clause did not land; the restore control itself was discovered unaided and read correctly. Restore was then completed after the fourth clause alone was re-stated (no route disclosure; control already located unaided), so restore-dependent criteria are valid evidence with that provenance. ARTIFACT VERIFIED POST-RESTORE: status Active Work, version 8 to 9, prior park event retained plus new 'Restored to Active Work in prototype - attributed to Joe' entry, all five read-back fields flipped Excluded to Included, no history rewrite and no loss. Criteria met: attributed events, read-back, no data loss, version visible. UNTESTED and the reason this is scored partial rather than pass: the conflict half of criterion 1 was never exercised — this journey's flow creates no version conflict, and the conflict state is reachable only through the Preview state selector, which was not used. CROSS-CUTTING EVIDENCE-VALIDITY FINDING, verified in source at workspace/public/js/app.js lines 92-108: journeySteps() renders unconditionally on both Command Center and Deal Room, displaying the expected route as numbered chips with current-step tracking, behind no toggle and no preview-state gate. Workspace journeys therefore cannot be described as purely uncoached, and this applies retroactively to FLOW-WS-01 as scored. Counter-signal limiting the severity: the chips read '5. Restore' and the step was still missed, so the displayed route does not reliably transfer. Timing not instrumented this run; journey carries no speed criterion.

journeys.name: Weekly Deal Room call
journeys.task_statement: Run this week's Deal Room call from start to finish, then review what it produced and handle retention correctly.
journeys.friction_notes: Run unaided and completed end to end. RUN AUTHENTICITY VERIFIED AGAINST THE SHIPPED FIXTURE rather than taken from the partner's report: fixtures/call-review.v1.json ships capture_stage 'ready' with all_candidates_dispositioned, aggregate_summary_confirmed, legal_hold, policy_resolved, recovery_window_elapsed and purge_eligible all false. Observed end state was capture_stage 'complete' with dispositioned and aggregate-confirmed true, which app.js sets only inside the complete-call action (lines 386-389), whose control is disabled while any candidate remains pending (line 135). Joe therefore drove ready to recording to review, dispositioned every candidate individually (all read 'confirmed', none skipped), then confirmed the aggregate summary to reach complete. ALL FIVE CRITERIA MET: (1) parked records excluded — 'Parked records excluded: Paused prospect demo' rendered explicitly alongside the two active records, and the pre-check confirmed this list is fixture-sourced and independent of the Myrick record's state, so journey 2's restore did not contaminate it; (2) no guessed speaker or target — every candidate in all seven sections carries 'Exact target: wrk-demo-001 - confirmed', with Joe actions and Dell actions separated and participants named; (3) draft-only outside communication — 'Prepare a check-in draft for review; sending is unavailable' plus the boundary note 'Outside communication remains a draft. Sending is structurally absent. There is no transcript library'; (4) all candidates dispositioned — reported Yes AND mechanically enforced by the disabled finish control, not merely displayed; (5) purge gate truthful — reported Blocked with the reason naming exactly the unmet conditions while correctly reporting legal hold explicitly false as Yes, and purge_eligible is computed as the conjunction of all five flags at line 391, so the gate cannot display Eligible unless every condition actually holds. Criteria 4 and 5 are enforced structurally rather than cosmetically, which is stronger evidence than a visual check. MINOR FRICTION, not a criterion, CAUSE CORRECTED 2026-08-12T19:53 after journey 4: the 'Work initiated by Doc, Claude, or Codex' section rendered as a heading with no content. This was first recorded as a missing empty-state message. The actual cause is Sterile mode, which Joe had toggled on earlier in the session: css/app.css line 201 applies 'body.sterile .internal-only { display: none !important }', and app.js line 137 marks those initiated-work cards internal-only. The section was therefore suppressed by an active mode with no notice, not empty. The five scored criteria are unaffected and the pass stands. Cross-cutting coaching affordance applies here as it does to all Workspace journeys — journeySteps() rendered the four-step route (Consent gate, Recording, Independent structured review, Retention eligibility) unconditionally. Timing not instrumented; journey carries no speed criterion.

journeys.name: Doc context and engineering request
journeys.task_statement: Ask Doc a grounded question about what you're looking at, then report a problem or improvement and see it through to a submitted request.
journeys.friction_notes: Joe stopped the run himself and reported it stuck, in his words: 'it keeps bouncing between work or needs answer and fresh verification. wont go to complete.' THE STUCK IS A REAL PRODUCT DEAD END, NOT USER ERROR, and it is caused by Sterile mode. MECHANISM, verified in source and in the live DOM: css/app.css line 201 applies 'body.sterile .internal-only { display: none !important }'. app.js line 155 places the request's entire internal panel in an internal-only card — request id, origin, reporter, owner, executor, the four-item completion evidence gate, AND the only control that can satisfy that gate, 'Attach synthetic fresh verification evidence', which renders solely when state is in_progress and evidence is not yet fresh. app.js line 149 offers, in in_progress, the Complete action ONLY when evidenceFresh is true, otherwise just 'Record needs-answer question'; line 150 offers, in needs_answer, only 'Record answer and resume'. With Sterile mode active the evidence control is invisible, so in_progress and needs_answer point at each other and Completed is unreachable with no on-screen explanation. Live DOM at the time of the run: body.className 'sterile', Sterile mode button aria-pressed 'true', .internal-only computed display 'none', hidden text beginning 'Needs_answerENG-DEMO-104OriginMyrick demo recordReporterJoeOwnerJoeExecutorSynthetic bounded Codex task'. ATTRIBUTION, corrected by Joe against an earlier wrong reading by this session: Sterile mode is NOT the shipped default and is NOT persisted — index.html body carries no class, there is no localStorage or sessionStorage anywhere in public/js, and the class is reachable only through the toggle handler at app.js line 591. Joe toggled it earlier in the session and reported 'i toggled sterile mode in an earlier phase but it didnt do anything', which is the compounding defect: the toggle produced no visible effect on the surface he was on, gives no persistent indication that a mode is active beyond aria-pressed on a small ghost button, and then silently removed load-bearing controls on a different surface several journeys later. CRITERIA: (1) exact request ID — FAIL as run; ENG-DEMO-104 exists in the DOM but is invisible; (2) no broad authority — design intent is met, executor reads 'Synthetic bounded Codex task', but it is hidden so it cannot be judged on screen; (3) executor and evidence visible — FAIL as run, both hidden; (4) Completed impossible without fresh proof — met, and over-met, since Completed is impossible at all. CONTRAST WORTH ACTING ON: app.js line 261 handles the same mode correctly on the whole-market surface, refusing with an explicit named notice, 'Whole-market view refused in Sterile mode ... Exit Sterile mode to use it.' Sterile suppression is therefore explained on one surface and silent on the two internal-only surfaces. SCOPE BOUNDED: internal-only appears exactly twice, app.js lines 137 and 155, so journeys 1 and 2 were not affected by this mode; journey 3's orphaned initiated-work heading was. RE-RUN REQUIRED in Normal mode to score criteria 1-3 as designed, and any such re-run MUST be marked coached true: this session disclosed to Joe that a hidden card exists and that it contains the control which breaks the loop. Re-run deliberately deferred rather than run immediately, per the standing proctor rule. Timing not instrumented.

journeys.name: Multi-stop Tour Mode
journeys.task_statement: Plan a multi-stop tour around your locked appointment, take it offline, capture a note and a photo along the way, and review what it proposes when you finish.
journeys.friction_notes: Run completed to stage 'complete' unaided. RUN AUTHENTICITY VERIFIED AGAINST THE FIXTURE: fixtures/tour.v1.json ships stage 'route_proposed', route_confirmed false, offline_pack.status 'not_requested' and verified false, resume.acknowledged_strokes 0, resume.photos 0, and both review_items 'pending'. Observed end state was complete with the pack ready and verified, which requires the full chain confirm-route, download-tour-pack, verify-tour-pack, start-tour, finish-tour, and complete-tour-review, the last of which is guarded at app.js line 430 so every review item must be dispositioned first. PRIMARY DEFECT, reported by Joe in his own words and then confirmed in source: 'when i clicked capture a note nothing happened. when i clicked capture a photo nothing happened.' He is correct and the cause is precise. app.js lines 418-419 make capture-note and capture-photo increment resume.acknowledged_strokes and resume.photos, and render() IS called at line 461 so the page does redraw, but the in_progress controls at line 167 display NEITHER counter. The counts surface only in the paused branch at line 168, 'N acknowledged stroke batch(es) and N photo(s) remain local'. A control labelled 'Acknowledge note stroke batch' therefore acknowledges nothing on screen, and a partner must simulate an offline interruption before the prototype will admit it recorded anything. CRITERIA: (1) locked appointment preserved — PASS, markers 1 and 3 retain '9:00 AM locked' and '11:15 AM locked' in original order 1-2-3; (2) map/list order matches — PASS, parity asserted with identical marker, stop ID and order across map and list; (3) exact resume — PASS ON TESTIMONY ONLY, Joe reports going offline and resuming, and the mechanism is consistent, but the completed state no longer renders the resume cursor so this is not artifact-verifiable; (4) acknowledged evidence not lost — CONTESTED, and this is why the journey scores partial rather than pass. Under a retention reading the append-only local evidence is preserved, including through conflict resolution 'server_route_with_append_only_local_evidence'. Under an acknowledgment reading the criterion fails outright, because no acknowledgment is rendered at the moment of capture. THE CONTRACT WORDING DOES NOT SETTLE WHICH READING IS INTENDED AND NEEDS JOE'S RULING; the defect above stands under either reading; (5) no record write without confirmation — PASS, 'No business record changed outside this browser'; (6) Goodnotes remains optional share flow — VACUOUS. Goodnotes appears nowhere in the implementation. A worktree-wide search finds it only in workspace/contracts/state-machines.v1.json line 136, council-review-register SET-007 and ADR-WS-009, threat-model B7, and the acceptance contract itself. The criterion can only pass by absence, which is no evidence either way and should be either implemented or struck. CROSS-CUTTING FINDING, second occurrence of the same shape as journey 4 and more serious than any single criterion: THE PROTOTYPE'S TERMINAL STATES ERASE THE EVIDENCE OF THE GATES THEY PASSED. From 'complete' the surface asserts 'Original note/photo evidence remains preserved' while displaying none of it, so criteria 3 and 4 cannot be checked after the fact by anyone, including a Phase 0 auditor. Acceptance evidence that is only observable mid-flow is not auditable evidence. TRACEABILITY GAP: the acceptance contract lists TOUR-ROUTE-001, TOUR-SYNC-001 and TOUR-REVIEW-001 as this journey's requirements, but the surface eyebrow cites only the first two, omitting TOUR-REVIEW-001 even though the review step is implemented and was exercised. Timing not instrumented.
